theorem backend.rbPartF_agree (γ : backend.BNames) (S S' : GoString → Prop) (r r' : GMap GoString
    backend.BktData) (F F' : GoString → Bool) : backend.rbPartF γ S r F ∗ backend.rbPartF γ S' r' F'
    ⊢ backend.rbPartF γ S r F ∗ backend.rbPartF γ S' r' F' ∗ ⌜(∀ (n : GoString), S n → S' n → r !! n
    = r' !! n) ∧ ∀ (n : GoString), S n → S' n → γ.rbD !! n ≠ none → F n = F' n⌝

    backend.BktData) (m : GoString) (S : backend.Data) (st st' : backend.BSess) (hC : st'.C = st.C)
    (hR : st'.R = st.R) (hO : ∀ (n : GoString), n ≠ m → st'.tk n = st.tk n ∧ backend.rbData P st'.S
    !! n = backend.rbData P st.S !! n) (hcw : st'.cw = st.cw) (hhw : st'.cnt.hw = st.cnt.hw) (c :
    Bool := false) {I : GoString → Prop} : backend.rbSide γ P r I ∗ backend.rbPart γ (fun k => k =
    m) (backend.rbData P S) ∗ backend.rbrSide γ P st c ⊢ backend.rbSide γ P r I ∗ backend.rbPart γ
    (fun k => k = m) (backend.rbData P S) ∗ backend.rbrSide γ P st' c

theorem backend.rbrSide_init (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) (hD : ∀
    (n : GoString), γ.rbD !! n ≠ none → P.RB n = true) (hcw : ∀ (n : GoString), st.cw n = false) :
    ((∃ M, ghostMapAuth γ.rbr 1 M) ∗ (∃ M, ghostMapAuth γ.rbc 1 M) ∗ [∗map] n ↦ _u ∈ γ.rbD, iprop(n
    ↪[γ.rbr]{#Qp.half 1} backend.rvBkt P (st.C, st.R) n ∗ n ↪[γ.rbc] none)) ⊢ backend.rbrSide γ P st

    backend.rvBkt P rv n ∗ n ↪[gc] none)

theorem backend.trkSide_upd (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (st st' : backend.BSess) (rv
    rv' : backend.RView) (hrv : rv = (st.C, st.R)) (hrv' : rv' = (st'.C, st'.R)) (hS : st'.S = st.S)
    (hk : ∀ (n : GoString), P.RB n = true → st.tk n = backend.RbK.idle → st'.tk n = backend.RbK.idle
    ∧ backend.rvBkt P rv n = backend.rvBkt P rv' n) (hcw : ∀ (n : GoString), st.cw n = false) (hcw'
    : ∀ (n : GoString), st'.cw n = false) : backend.trkSide γ P st ⊢ backend.rbrHalves γ P 1 rv
    ={⊤}=∗ backend.rbrHalves γ P 1 rv' ∗ backend.trkSide γ P st'

theorem backend.rbSide_put (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (r r' : GMap GoString
    backend.BktData) (n : GoString) (hBT : ∃ i, P.BT !! n = some i) (hRB : P.RB n = true) (hO : ∀ (m
    : GoString), m ≠ n → r' !! m = r !! m) (I I' : GoString → Prop) (hI : ∀ (m : GoString), m ≠ n →
    I m → I' m) : backend.rbSide γ P r I ∗ backend.rbPart γ (fun m => m = n) r ⊢ |==>
    (backend.rbSide γ P r' I' ∗ backend.rbPart γ (fun m => m = n) r')

theorem backend.rbrSide_step (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (st st' : backend.BSess) (rv
    rv' : backend.RView) (hrv : rv = (st.C, st.R)) (hrv' : rv' = (st'.C, st'.R)) (hS :
    backend.rbData P st'.S = backend.rbData P st.S) (hk : ∀ (n : GoString), P.RB n = true → st.tk n
    = backend.RbK.idle → st'.tk n = backend.RbK.idle ∧ backend.rvBkt P rv n = backend.rvBkt P rv' n)

    backend.rbrSide γ P st ∗ backend.rbrHalves γ P 1 rv ⊢ |==> (backend.rbrSide γ P st' ∗
    backend.rbrHalves γ P 1 rv')

theorem backend.rbrSide_writeR (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (m : GoString) (st st' :
    backend.BSess) (hC : st'.C = st.C) (hR : st'.R = st.R) (hBT : P.RB m = true → ∃ i, P.BT !! m =
    some i) (hO : ∀ (n : GoString), n ≠ m → st'.tk n = st.tk n ∧ st'.S !! n = st.S !! n ∧ st'.cw n =
    st.cw n) (hcl : st.tk m = backend.RbK.idle ∨ st.cw m = true → st'.tk m = backend.RbK.idle ∨
    st'.cw m = true) (I I' : GoString → Prop) (hI : ∀ (n : GoString), n ≠ m → I n → I' n) :
    backend.rbSide γ P (backend.rbData P st.S) I ∗ backend.rbPutR γ P m st.S ∗ backend.rbrSide γ P
    st true ⊢ |==> (backend.rbSide γ P (backend.rbData P st'.S) I' ∗ backend.rbPutR γ P m st'.S ∗
    backend.rbrSide γ P st' true)

theorem backend.rbWrite (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (st st' : backend.BSess) (m :
    GoString) (k c : Bool) (hC : st'.C = st.C) (hR : st'.R = st.R) (hhw : st'.cnt.hw = st.cnt.hw)
    (hBT : P.RB m = true → ∃ i, P.BT !! m = some i) (hB : P.RB m = false → backend.rbData P st'.S =
    backend.rbData P st.S) (hO : ∀ (n : GoString), n ≠ m → st'.tk n = st.tk n ∧ st'.S !! n = st.S !!
    n ∧ st'.cw n = st.cw n) (hcw : k = false → st'.cw m = st.cw m) (hcwT : k = true → st.tk m =
    backend.RbK.idle ∨ st.cw m = true → st'.tk m = backend.RbK.idle ∨ st'.cw m = true) (hkc : k =
    true → c = true) : backend.rbSide γ P (backend.rbData P st.S) (backend.tkI P st) ∗ backend.rbPut
    γ P m st.S k ∗ backend.rbrSide γ P st c ⊢ |==> (backend.rbSide γ P (backend.rbData P st'.S)
    (backend.tkI P st') ∗ backend.rbPut γ P m st'.S k ∗ backend.rbrSide γ P st' c)
